_: Blind forced-choice listening test, webui/ab_check.html, one listener (the author), 2026-08-16. The gate on issue #16: does the search-space widening that won the objective also win an ear?
_setup: 24 trials, 3 per category, the pairs the two arms disagree on most under CLAP. Same 64 targets, same engine, same budget 800, same seed; only $SPACE differs (base 22 dims vs fx 26 dims = CC93 reverb, CC94 chorusd, CC95 echod, CC82 dtime, and CC91 room which base carried but never rendered). A/B coin-flipped per trial, levels peak-normalised, answer key not read until every trial was voted. One held note, 1.6 s gate + 0.3 s tail -- the window the search optimised.
_result: armbase 9, armfx 7, tie 8, on both questions. Exact two-sided sign test on n=16 decided trials: p = 0.80. A null: the ear does not hear what bank_compare.py measures. armfx wins 48 of 64 slots against armbase under both STFT and CLAP at p = 0.0001, and that margin does not reach a listener at all.
_power: n=16 decided trials needs a 13-3 split to clear p<0.05, so this rules out a large effect, not a small one. But the effect the objective claims is not small -- 48-16 is the same margin the $LOSS test cleared at p=7.6e-05 with an ear behind it (ab_votes_soundfont.json, 18-1). The mean pair spread here is 0.255 against that test's 0.385, which is the same finding from the other side: these two arms differ less than those two losses did.
_caveat: One listener, not blinded to the hypothesis (only to the assignment), n=24, single notes. The two questions came back identical in all 24 trials again, so this rig still cannot separate 'fits the target better' from 'is the better patch'.
_conclusion: Nothing promoted. presets_soundfont.json stays as fitted at SPACE=base, the arms stay gitignored. The widening is kept in params.py because it is measured and because $SPACE=fx is what makes CC91 reachable at all -- but a decisive objective win, a duller attack (centroid 0.777 -> 0.707) and a null listening test together say the loss found something that is not the sound.
